pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/Cargo.toml:3 The crate is serde/schemars wire types plus pure predicates and a schema-export example; a search of every tracked file under crates/shadowrunr-types for Mutex, RwLock, Atomic, in_flight, idempot, single_flight, fencing, lease, Semaphore and tokio found zero hits, and its dependencies (serde, serde_json, thiserror, async-trait, schemars) carry no sync or runtime primitive, so no operation here acquires, releases or races a guard.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/examples/export-schema.rs:26 Writes in place, but only as a developer-run codegen step into committed contract schema files (driven by packages/contract scripts); no process polls the file while it is written. If a live reader is ever added, this becomes a deviation (no write-temp-then-rename).
